crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin hits lowest level since September 2024, then bounces
crypto_headlines.summary: BTC fell to a low of about $55,130 overnight before climbing back above $59,000, with Ethereum back above $1,650.

crypto_headlines.title: $2.7B in leveraged crypto positions liquidated in 24 hours
crypto_headlines.summary: The Kobeissi Letter says it is the 11th-largest liquidation event in crypto market history.

crypto_headlines.title: Kraken BTC/CAD pair flash-crashes, trades stand
crypto_headlines.summary: Kraken's BTC/CAD pair dropped as low as C$24,250 (about $16,900) while BTC traded around $57K elsewhere, and Kraken says every trade stands.

crypto_headlines.title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs post a fourth straight day of outflows
crypto_headlines.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $124.4M in net outflows on Nov 20, per SoSoValue, bringing the week to about $1.24B out.

crypto_headlines.title: Crypto Fear and Greed Index drops to 6
crypto_headlines.summary: That is lower than the readings during the 2020 Covid crash and the FTX and Luna collapses.

crypto_headlines.title: Strategy's BTC stack sits on a $14.96B unrealized loss
crypto_headlines.summary: Strategy holds 850,849 BTC at an average purchase price of $75,452.

doginal_news.title: Official Black Friday swag sale is live
doginal_news.summary: Doginal Dogs opened its Black Friday sale with every swag item up for grabs one last time, limited stock while supplies last.

doginal_news.title: Free Santa Gary promo card with $299+ orders
doginal_news.summary: A Santa Gary promo card is automatically added to qualifying carts of $299 or more. It is not sold separately and is available while supplies last.

doginal_news.title: Pyth Pro adds more global markets
doginal_news.summary: New coverage includes expanded US equities with 24/5 ANT, Taiwan equities, more Pyth Indices, commodity and VIX futures, and more FX and 24/7 crypto feeds.

doginal_news.title: PIRB on pricing a market crash
doginal_news.summary: PIRB posted about how a crash is only as clear as the precision of the prices you see, down to the millisecond.
